target.name: runtime-installed IWRAM byte-lane table transform
target.role: byte-lane transform: the four 0xFF-masked lanes of each source word mapped through a caller-supplied 256-byte table and packed back in place, four bytes per pass
target.notes: THE THIRD BATCH OF THE SAME RUNTIME-INSTALLED BLOCK. The 4100 bytes at ROM 0x087B79A4..0x087B89A8 are the image of IWRAM 0x03000000..0x03001004, installed by the reset code's second DMA3 program (SAD 0x087B79A4, DAD 0x03000000, CNT 0x84000401 = 1025 words), so IWRAM X = ROM 0x087B79A4 + (X - 0x03000000) and every byte is statically known. The block's code half ends at 0x03000F44; this batch covers the byte-lane and Q-format transform families inside it. THE ROUTINE is 0x087B7C80 (IWRAM 0x030002DC), 76 bytes and 19 ARM instructions, ending at the `bx lr` at IWRAM 0x03000324. It has NO literal pool at all: every instruction is register-only. THE 76-BYTE EXTENT IS A CORRECTION, and the correction matters. The previous ticket's brief and this ticket's brief both called the window to the next entry 84 bytes; the two words at IWRAM 0x03000328 (`0x000037FF`, `0x0000027F`) are NOT this routine's. Exactly two instructions in the whole block read them - `ldr r8,[pc,#0xf0]` at 0x03000230 and `ldr r8,[pc,#0xe4]` at 0x03000240, whose pc-relative targets are 0x03000328 and 0x0300032C - and both lie inside the 149-word routine at 0x03000040 that precedes this one. Decoded as code those words read `strdeq r3,r4,[r0],-pc` and `andeq r0,r0,pc,ror r2`. The 84-byte figure is the entry-to-next-entry window and counts two data words as instructions, which is precisely the method this project forbids. THE EQUATION, executed and checked rather than named: for each source word, out.lane k = (in.lane k == 0) ? 0 : table[in.lane k], with the lane map the IDENTITY - neither routine in the family permutes bytes. `T[0]` IS NEVER READ: the `ands` that computes each lane sets Z and the following `ldrbne` is predicated on it, so a zero lane does not read the table even at index 0. Every count is in BYTES and the pass stride is four. THE BOUNDARIES, reproduced and not repaired: there is NO pre-test on the count, and the counter is decremented by four at the END of each pass with an exit on exactly zero. A count of zero therefore wraps the counter through 2^32 and runs 2^30 passes, and a count that is not a multiple of four NEVER TERMINATES. Neither is guarded, because the cartridge has no guard. WHO CALLS IT: the Thumb-to-ARM veneer at 0x0804918C, which has exactly three Thumb BL callers in the image - 0x08030EBC, 0x0803D99C and 0x0803F9FA - and all three set r0 = r1 = the SAME address and r2 = the 256-byte ROM table at 0x0805672C, so the operation is an in-place byte substitution through a fixed table. The table's MEANING is UNKNOWN and no compression, container or opcode meaning is imported from another title; 0x0805672C occurs exactly once in the whole image as a word, at 0x08030F30, which is the literal slot the 0x08030EBC call site loads. THE SECOND FAMILY MEMBER is a separate target, `iwramblsparse`, because eight bytes of a third routine's pool separate the two addresses.

ads_match.detail: an ARM Developer Suite 1.2 installation is present on this machine but the licence file it ships licenses a different product, so the ARM compilers cannot be run. No compile has been attempted and no configuration has been tested. The installation is located through ADS12_ROOT.
required_to_unblock: a licensed ADS 1.2 installation, with ADS12_ROOT pointing at it

verdicts_are_independent: SEMANTIC, MODERN_BUILD and ADS_MATCH answer different questions and none is evidence for another. A passing modern build says nothing about the original compiler; a passing semantic run only removes one class of error.

identity.why_not: the original translation unit was built by ARM Developer Suite 1.2 (the surviving command line names tcpp). GCC is a different compiler with a different code generator, so its output cannot establish anything about ADS 1.2.

literal_pools.interpretation: the original's literals are accounted for by the words the unit declares; the modern build pools differently, which is a structural consequence of the compiler rather than a defect in the reconstruction. It is also why a function with a literal load cannot be compared standalone.

comparison.match_claim_note: MEASUREMENT ONLY. This compares a modern GCC build against the cartridge. A modern compiler is not the original compiler, so a difference here is expected and proves nothing; an identity here would also prove nothing about ADS 1.2. ADS_MATCH stays BLOCKED.
